en-US.description: Cross-platform fitting tool for EVE Online
en-US.longDescription: Pyfa, short for python fitting assistant, allows you to create, experiment with, and save ship fittings without being in game. Open source and written in Python, it is available on any platform where Python 3 and wxWidgets are available, including Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en-US.name: pyfa
en-US.releaseNotes:
Database:
- Updated to the latest version of release 24.02
  - Note: synchronizer rigs seem to have a CPU output reduction, and skill reduces it, not main penalty; this is how it currently should work in EVE.
Changes:
- Price optimization still works like it used to if ship has no synchronizer rigs. However, if a synchronizer rig is added, modules which boost it are not considered equal to modules of other faction for price optimization anymore.
Fixes:
- Fixed bastion hull resistance bonus (#2815)

zh-CN.description: 星战前夜的跨平台配船工具
zh-CN.longDescription: Pyfa 是 python fitting assistant 的简称，允许您在不进入游戏的情况下创建、试验和保存舰船装配。Pyfa 是用 Python 编写的开源软件，适用于任何支持 Python 3 和 wxWidgets 的平台，包括 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
